items.title: Henry "Jack" Palmer Interview
items.q: I recorded with, uh, Joe Jordan's Tim Sharp.

ctx.x: Can you recall recording with some other girl singer or some other band?

No, I, well, I recorded with, uh, oh, I recorded with quite a few bands. I recorded with, uh, Joe Jordan's Tim Sharp. With whom? Joe Jordan's Tim Sharp. That's what it was. Joe Jordan? Really? That's what we feel.
Joe, you were piano player on that. Oh, yeah.
